papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: This prospective phase II XXX trial evaluated high-dose thoracic reirradiation for in-field recurrent lung cancer while respecting the cumulative dose to the organs at risk. Here, we report the toxicity and dosimetric results of the XXX trial. METHODS: Patients with recurrent lung cancer within 5cm of the previously irradiated high-dose region (50Gy10 EQD2) were eligible. Patients were treated in a radical setting (≥45Gy10 EQD2) using conventionally (chemo)radiotherapy or stereotactic radiotherapy. Cumulative dose constraints were: tracheobronchial tree Dmax 110Gy3 EQD2, esophagus Dmax 100Gy3 EQD2 and spinal cord Dmax 75Gy3 EQD2. All doses were converted to EQD2 using α/β values of 10Gy (Gy10) for the tumor or acute effects and 3Gy for late effects (Gy3). RESULTS: Sixty patients were included. Thirty-eight patients were reirradiated with conventionally (chemo)radiotherapy most commonly 50Gy in 25 fractions or 60Gy in 30 fractions, while 22 patients received stereotactic radiotherapy most commonly 52.5Gy in 7 fractions. After a median follow-up of 26 months, no grade 4-5 toxicity was reported. Ten patients (17%) experienced grade 3 toxicity, including 7 cases of radiation pneumonitis. Dosimetric data were available for 59 patients. Median prescribed reirradiation dose was 60Gy10 EQD2, resulting in a median cumulative PTV Dmax of 130Gy10 EQD2. The cumulative esophagus dose exceeded 80Gy3 in 20 patients, cumulative trachea dose exceeded 80 Gy3 in 26 patients and cumulative bronchus dose exceeded 100Gy3 in 26 patients. Both cumulative lung V20 and cumulative mean lung dose were significantly associated with grade 2-3 radiation pneumonitis (p-value <0.05), whereas cumulative V5 was not. CONCLUSION: Thoracic reirradiation with a radical dose to the tumor while respecting cumulative organs at risk constraints was feasible in this prospective trial. Grade 2-3 radiation pneumonitis was associated with cumulative mean lung dose and cumulative lung V20. No grade 4-5 esophageal, airway or spinal cord toxicity occurred despite high cumulative doses.

The vast majority had no external validation in an intended use cohort. papers.abstract_en: Current risk prediction tools for indeterminate pulmonary nodules (IPNs) are imperfect and there is a growing body of research in biomarkers to aid management. We undertook this systematic review to evaluate the current landscape of molecular biomarkers designed for IPN risk stratification. PubMed, CINAHL Complete, and Scopus databases were searched through December 2024. Clinical validation or utility studies of non-invasive molecular biomarkers for IPNs (<30mm) were included. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-2. Database and citation searching identified 1,577 studies from 2007-2024. After abstract and full-text screening, 106 studies were included in the systematic review. Of the 106 studies included, less than half validated the accuracy of the biomarker in an external cohort (n = 48, 45%), while most others (n = 47, 44%) used a split-validation design. The median size of the validation cohort was 112.5 (range: 29 to 1,679). Protein biomarkers were the most commonly evaluated (n = 73), followed by genetic/nucleic acid compounds (n = 40). Risk of bias assessment using the QUADAS-2 tool found 9 studies to be at low risk across all domains, and many studies had an unclear risk due to lack of reporting or clarity. This review highlights the growing and diverse field of molecular biomarker development for the evaluation of pulmonary nodules. The vast majority had no external validation in an intended use cohort. Improvements must be made to the completeness of reporting in the field to address issues with risk of bias and applicability of study results.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: In the ADRIATIC study, consolidation durvalumab significantly improved dual primary endpoints of overall and progression-free survival versus placebo for patients with limited-stage SCLC (LS-SCLC) and no progression following concurrent chemoradiotherapy (cCRT). We report post-hoc, exploratory analyses of patterns of disease progression. METHODS: Patients were randomized to receive durvalumab, durvalumab-tremelimumab (not reported), or placebo, stratified by disease stage and prophylactic cranial irradiation use, and were treated until progression or intolerable toxicity, or for up to 24 months. First site of progression (BICR per RECIST v1.1) was classified as intrathoracic (any lesion within the lungs and mediastinum) and/or extrathoracic (lesions outside the lungs, including chest wall/diaphragm). Time to progression or death for intrathoracic progression, extrathoracic progression, and brain/central nervous system progression were assessed by Kaplan‒Meier methods. RESULTS: In the durvalumab (n=264) and placebo (n=266) arms, 47.7% and 59.4% of patients, respectively, had progression; rates of intrathoracic-only progression were 27.7% and 29.3%. Extrathoracic lesions occurred in 20.1% and 30.1% of patients in the durvalumab and placebo arms, respectively; the most common site was the brain (6.8% and 12.4%). Time to intrathoracic progression or death (HR 0.81 [95% CI: 0.61‒1.08]) and time to extrathoracic progression or death (HR 0.68 [95% CI: 0.49‒0.93]), including brain progression or death (HR 0.64 [95% CI: 0.40‒1.01]), favored durvalumab versus placebo. CONCLUSION: The lower rate of extrathoracic progression and prolonged time to progression or death for intrathoracic and extrathoracic (including brain) lesions observed with durvalumab versus placebo further support consolidation durvalumab as the new standard-of-care treatment for patients with LS-SCLC without progression after cCRT.

papers.abstract_en: Background Microwave ablation (MWA) combined with ethanol injection (EI) is a minimally invasive technique under preliminary investigation for the treatment of nodular retrosternal goiter (RSG) and has shown promising treatment efficacy. However, a comparative analysis between ablation and surgery is warranted to draw definitive conclusions. Purpose To compare the long-term efficacy and safety of MWA combined with EI versus surgery for patients with nodular RSG. Materials and Methods This retrospective study included patients with nodular RSG treated with MWA combined with EI or surgery between October 2016 and June 2024. Propensity score matching was performed for patients in the ablation and surgery groups, followed by comparisons between the two groups with independent-sample t test, Mann-Whitney U test, χ2, or Fisher exact test. Primary outcomes were treatment success, symptom score, and complication rate. Secondary outcomes were cosmetic score, hospitalization, procedure time, estimated blood loss, incision length, and cost. Results This study included 555 patients (mean age ± SD, 51 years ± 14.4; 414 women). After propensity score matching, 224 patients in the ablation group and 224 patients in the surgery group were observed for a median of 48 months (IQR, 24-60 months). No evidence of a difference was observed in the treatment success rates between the ablation and surgery group (98.7% [221 of 224] vs 100% [224 of 224], respectively; P = .08), while both modalities effectively lowered symptom scores from baseline (both P < .001). Compared with surgery, MWA resulted in a lower complication rate (2.2% [five of 224] vs 34.8% [78 of 224], P < .001), shorter posttreatment hospitalization (P < .001), shorter procedure time (P < .001), reduced estimated blood loss (P < .001), shorter incision length (P < .001), lower cost (P < .001), and lower cosmetic score (mean, 1.1 ± 0.3 vs 1.2 ± 0.4; P = .03) at the 12-month follow-up. Conclusion MWA combined with EI was as effective as surgery for nodular RSGs, providing comparable symptom relief while demonstrating fewer complications, offering a safer alternative for eligible patients. © RSNA, 2026 Supplemental material is available for this article.

papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary hypertension, defined by elevated pressure in the pulmonary circulation, is morbid and diagnosing is challenging as no early-stage blood markers are currently available. Here we show that large-scale proteomic profiling across several independent observational cohorts identifies 22 proteins associated with echocardiography-derived pulmonary artery systolic pressure, several of which are independently associated with invasive measures of pulmonary vascular disease, structural remodeling of the pulmonary vasculature, and subsequent risk of pulmonary hypertension. Genetic analyses support a potential causal role for NOTCH3 and identify a common splice-regulating genetic variant that may modify susceptibility to pulmonary vascular stressors. Protein-based clustering further reveals two distinct biological subtypes associated with increased risk of pulmonary hypertension. Together, these findings identify candidate biomarkers of pulmonary hypertension, implicate pulmonary vascular remodeling in early-stage disease with a potential causal role for NOTCH3, and discover and validate two distinct endotypes of pulmonary hypertension risk in the community.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Inhaled corticosteroid (ICS)-containing reliever therapy has demonstrated efficacy in improving asthma outcomes when compared to short-acting beta2-agonists (SABA) alone but remains underutilized. The purpose of this guideline is to provide recommendations surrounding the use of combination ICS-formoterol or ICS+SABA (in combination or separate inhalers) as reliever therapy across the asthma severity spectrum in adolescents and adults. METHODS: The American Thoracic Society clinical practice guideline panel evaluated six research questions in the PICO format addressing the use of ICS-containing reliever therapy across National Asthma Education and Prevention Program (NAEPP) asthma treatment steps 1-5. The methodology team conducted systematic literature reviews and GRADE assessments, which the panel utilized to inform the recommendations for each specific PICO and overall. RECOMMENDATIONS: In patients at NAEPP steps 1 and 2, the panel made strong recommendations for the use of as-needed-only ICS-SABA or ICS-formoterol over SABA-only therapy, and conditional recommendations over scheduled ICS + as-needed SABA. In patients at NAEPP steps 3-5, the taskforce made a strong recommendation for the use of maintenance-and-reliever therapy (MART) with ICS-formoterol over scheduled ICS-LABA plus as-needed SABA. In patients at NAEPP steps 3-5 who are using scheduled maintenance ICS-LABA, the panel made a conditional recommendation for use of ICS+SABA reliever over SABA reliever. In considering these recommendations, the panel valued the importance of preventing severe exacerbations and considered the risk of SABA-only treatment, as well as ICS and systemic corticosteroid (SCS) exposure. CONCLUSIONS: This clinical practice guideline, informed by systematic reviews and GRADE-based appraisals of PICO-framed evidence, makes these evidence-based recommendations for the safe and effective use of ICS-containing reliever therapy in asthma.

papers.ai_note: 主要终点为体重增加这一耐受性/替代性指标且结果阳性，但疾病控制相关终点方向均不利（IgE下降更少、一年急性加重更多），摘要以阳性主要终点开篇而将不利的疾病控制数据置于其后；复合终点未达统计学显著（HR 1.83，p=0.084），却单独强调其中一个次要终点急性加重p=0.048。开放标签、单中心，体重与IgE评估可能受知晓分组影响；随访称2年但摘要未报告2年结果。信息不足：未报告两组具体剂量与等效剂量换算、IgE下降与急性加重的定义及基线严重度分层。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Systemic glucocorticoids are effective in allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (ABPA) but cause adverse effects (AEs). Deflazacort may have fewer metabolic AEs than prednisolone. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether deflazacort reduces weight gain while maintaining disease control in ABPA. METHODS: In this investigator-initiated, single-center, open-label, parallel-group randomized trial, adults with newly diagnosed ABPA were assigned 1:1 to oral prednisolone or oral deflazacort for 16 weeks. The primary outcome was percentage weight gain at eight weeks. Secondary outcomes included decline in serum total IgE, treatment response, ABPA exacerbations, and treatment-emergent AEs (TEAEs). The follow-up was two years. RESULTS: We randomized 178 patients (89 per group; mean age, 35.5 years; 48.3% women). Mean percentage weight gain at eight weeks was lower with deflazacort than prednisolone (2.97% vs. 4.87%; mean difference, -1.9 percentage points; 95% CI, -3.32 to -0.48; p=0.009). Treatment response at eight weeks was similar (95.5% vs. 98.9%; p=0.213). However, the mean percentage decline in serum total IgE from baseline at 16 weeks was smaller with deflazacort (55.2% vs. 62.1%; p=0.024), and one-year ABPA exacerbations were more frequent (18.0% vs. 7.9%; p=0.048). The hazard ratio for the composite outcome of 8-week treatment failure or first subsequent ABPA exacerbation was 1.83 [95% CI, 0.92-3.61]; log-rank p=0.084). TEAEs were similar between groups. CONCLUSIONS: Deflazacort reduced early weight gain and achieved similar 8-week treatment response rates, but was associated with a smaller decline in serum total IgE at 16 weeks and more ABPA exacerbations at one year. Further dose-ranging studies are warranted.

papers.title_en: Development and Validation of a Gene Expression-Based Prognostic Model for Patients With Small Cell Lung Cancer Treated With Chemotherapy.
papers.authors: Liu T, Zhou T, Mo S, Ge M, Ma W, Zhan J, Chen X, Yang Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medical Oncology Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center Guangzhou China.
papers.authors_conclusion: SCLC-PRS模型是一种创新的、跨平台兼容的、临床可应用的预后工具，具有风险分层和个体化治疗的潜在效用
papers.ai_note: HR方向与文中描述不一致：文中称PRS-H组生存更差，但报告HR=0.35（<1），需确认比较方向是否为PRS-L vs PRS-H；训练队列仅50例，外部验证队列均<50例，样本量小限制模型稳健性；免疫微环境描述为定性结论，未报告统计检验数值；摘要未提及决策曲线分析、C-index等模型判别力指标
papers.abstract_en: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) remains one of the most aggressive malignancies, with limited tools for predicting outcomes and guiding treatment. We developed an SCLC-Predictive Risk Score (PRS) model for patients treated with chemotherapy using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression. The model comprised five genes and was developed in a training cohort of 50 patients using an innovative 795-gene panel of tumor- and immune-related genes analyzed on the NanoString nCounter platform. Gene expression was measured in routine clinical formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded SCLC specimens, predominantly puncture specimens (36/50). The SCLC-PRS model stratified patients into high-risk (PRS-H) and low-risk (PRS-L) groups; patients in the PRS-H group had significantly worse overall survival (hazard ratio [HR] = 0.35, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.18-0.69; p = 0.002) and progression-free survival (HR = 0.44, 95% CI: 0.23-0.84; p = 0.008). The prognostic performance of the model was externally validated in two independent cohorts (GSE60052, n = 38; George cohort, n = 47). Multivariate Cox analysis confirmed SCLC-PRS as an independent prognostic factor. PRS-L tumors exhibit a favorable tumor immune microenvironment, with increased CD45+ immune infiltration, reduced Tregs or exhausted CD8+ T cells, and upregulated antigen presentation (MHC-I/II). Overall, the SCLC-PRS model is an innovative, cross-platform-compatible, and clinically applicable prognostic tool with potential utility for risk stratification and personalized treatment.

papers.authors: Lee JB, Yang J, Chalita M, Jung Y, Park H, Ro M, Kim H, Yang E et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Medical Oncology, Department of Internal Medicine, Yonsei Cancer Center, Yonsei University College of Medici…
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings highlight the importance of characterizing dysbiosis using gut microbial signatures, which act along a distinct and complementary axis to explain responses to ICIs.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要通篇无AUC/HR/OR、95%CI及具体P值，'improved response stratification'与'significant positive correlation'均无量化指标，无法判断增益幅度；应答定义将≥6个月SD纳入应答者，可能稀释菌群差异且与RECIST疗效判断口径不一致；膳食纤维与抗生素使用既是关联菌群的混杂因素也可能是应答的混杂因素，摘要未见校正说明；菌群评分依赖公开队列拼接，人群/测序/饮食差异的批次效应未描述；为观察性关联研究，无干预验证临床效用
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The gut microbiome has been linked to responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), yet longitudinal multi-omics studies remain limited. METHODS: Here, we serially collected gut microbiome data and performed multi-omics analyses, including RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and whole-exome sequencing (WES), on samples from 92 patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) treated with pembrolizumab, to identify factors contributing to treatment response. We compared gut microbiome data with those of a healthy cohort (n = 92) and examined changes in gut microbial signatures during immunotherapy. Gut microbiome data from publicly available ICI-treated cohorts (n = 728) were also used together with our own cohort to develop and validate a score for classifying response to ICIs. RESULTS: Responders (defined as complete response, partial response, or stable disease of at least 6 months) were enriched for Faecalibacterium, while non-responders were enriched for Lactobacillus and Escherichia, with these taxa showing specific associations with dietary fiber intake and antibiotic use. Dynamic shifts in dysbiotic signatures were observed throughout treatment and disease progression, with dissimilarity from the healthy cohort decreasing after treatment only in responders but increasing at progression in both responders and non-responders. We also developed a cross-population score based on the ratio of responder- to non-responder-associated microbial markers. This score showed a significant positive correlation with the index reflecting gut microbial health status and improved response stratification when combined with tumor mutational burden (TMB). CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight the importance of characterizing dysbiosis using gut microbial signatures, which act along a distinct and complementary axis to explain responses to ICIs.

papers.title_en: Biological sex-dependent hormonal signaling and metabolomic profiles in obesity alter tumor microenvironment and immunotherapy outcomes.
papers.authors: Vick LV, Rosario SR, Wang Z, Collins C, Khuat LT, Yang Y, Sheng MK, Firoz WA et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Dermatology, UC Davis School of Medicine, Sacramento, United States of America.
papers.authors_conclusion: 研究者认为免疫治疗的"肥胖悖论"具有性别依赖性，激素与代谢组学状态可调节肥胖对ICI疗效的影响。
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告任何效应量（HR/CI/P）、样本量、事件数及泛癌队列构成，"改善生存/结局"仅定性表述，信息不足；绝经状态以年龄≥55岁代理，可能不精确；泛癌结果是否适用于胸科肿瘤亚组未说明；机制证据来自小鼠DIO模型与卵巢切除，向人类外推需谨慎；卵巢切除减少M2极化为小鼠观察结果，未在人类样本中验证。
papers.abstract_en: Commonly viewed as a negative prognostic factor in cancer, obesity is associated with improved responses to cancer immunotherapy using immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Although data suggest a sexual dimorphism influencing the effects of obesity on immunotherapy responses, to our knowledge, the intersection of sex and obesity on immunotherapy requires further exploration. We demonstrate, in a pan-cancer analysis stratified by sex and BMI, that obesity (BMI ≥ 30) is associated with improved survival after ICI only in male patients. In preclinical models of diet-induced obesity (DIO), we observed that only DIO male tumor-bearing mice responded better to ICI. The differential effect of sex on outcomes was associated with alterations in the tumor microenvironment where DIO female mice demonstrated increased tumor-associated macrophages skewed toward a M2 phenotype. Ovariectomy of DIO female mice reduced M2 polarization and increased anti-tumor immune responses including increases in tumor-infiltrating T cells following ICI. Metabolomic analysis of DIO mice demonstrated distinct profiles base on sex. Re-stratification of female cancer patients revealed that obesity was associated with improved outcome, but only in post-menopausal (age ≥ 55) patients. We identify that the immunotherapy "obesity paradox" is sex-dependent and that hormonal and metabolomic status modulates the influence of obesity on ICIs.

Applying ultrasensitive MAESTRO assays to 331 plasma samples from 36 patients treated with curative intent, a recent article found 60% of ctDNA-positive samples were <100 ppm, and every recurrence preceded by postoperative ctDNA detection.

papers.title_zh: 局部晚期食管鳞癌dCRT后巩固化疗联合PD-1抑制剂的回顾性队列：OS/PFS延长但存在残留混杂与PD-L1分析不确定
papers.title_en: Efficacy and safety analysis of consolidation immunotherapy following definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
papers.authors: Liu W, Zhu Q, Xu S, Chen J, Wang D, Wu T, Shen J, Zhu Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiation Oncology, The People's Hospital Affiliated to Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: dCRT后巩固化疗联合PD-1抑制剂序贯维持与局部晚期ESCC更长的OS和PFS相关，且≥3级TRAEs相当；PD-L1分析因可评估组织少而无定论；这些发现需要更大队列验证。
papers.ai_note: 回顾性非随机设计，IPTW仅能控制已测量混杂，残留混杂与选择偏倚（仅纳入完成dCRT且无进展并接受巩固治疗者，存在不死时间/适应证混杂可能）未消除；干预组为化疗+PD-1后序贯维持的复合方案，无法区分免疫贡献。加权前后PFS差异大（25.4 vs 9.6 → 12.7 vs 9.2），提示权重对估计影响显著、样本量小导致估计不稳。安全性比较（17.8% vs 23.5%，P=0.660）效能不足，'相当'不等于非劣效。ORR为次要终点且为摘要重点突出项之一；PD-L1按作者自述无定论。摘要未报告95%CI，仅有P值。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy (dCRT) is standard for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), but recurrences remain common. Evidence for consolidation immunotherapy after dCRT is limited. This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of consolidation immunotherapy after dCRT and explored the association between programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression and treatment outcomes. METHODS: This multicenter retrospective cohort included ESCC patients who completed dCRT without progression and received consolidation chemotherapy alone or with a programmed death-1 (PD-1) inhibitor followed by maintenance (July 2019-December 2024). Inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) adjusted for baseline differences. Overall survival (OS), progression-free survival (PFS), objective response rate (ORR), and treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) were compared. PD-L1 expression was assessed by combined positive score (CPS) in evaluable tissue. RESULTS: Among 96 patients, 45 received consolidation chemotherapy plus a PD-1 inhibitor followed by maintenance and 51 received consolidation chemotherapy alone. Median OS (43.1 vs. 26.0 months; P = 0.014) and PFS (25.4 vs. 9.6 months; P = 0.014) were longer with immunotherapy. After IPTW, OS (37.6 vs. 25.6 months; P = 0.018) and PFS (12.7 vs. 9.2 months; P = 0.037) remained significant. ORR was higher with immunotherapy (60.0% vs. 27.4%; P = 0.001). PD-L1 was evaluable in 38 patients; subgroup analyses were exploratory. Grade ≥3 TRAEs did not differ significantly (17.8% vs. 23.5%; P = 0.660). CONCLUSION: Consolidation chemotherapy plus a PD-1 inhibitor followed by maintenance after dCRT was associated with longer OS and PFS in locally advanced ESCC, with comparable grade ≥3 TRAEs. PD-L1 analyses were inconclusive because few patients had evaluable tissue. These findings require validation in larger cohorts.

papers.title_zh: VV-ECMO救治常规治疗无效的致死性哮喘：12年单中心生存率98.7%但创伤后应激症状达37.2%

papers.authors: Abada M, Redfern A, Sampson C, Charlton M
papers.affiliation_highlight: Intensive Care Medicine, Glenfield Hospital, University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust, Leicester, UK.
papers.authors_conclusion: VV-ECMO是难治性致死性哮喘的有效救援治疗，在精心选择的病例中显示出优异的短期与长期生存结局；并发症发生率在此背景下仍属可接受且可控；本队列焦虑与抑郁患病率似乎低于已发表的更广泛ECMO人群系统综述报告，但创伤后应激症状发生率相对更高
papers.ai_note: 单中心无对照病例系列，98.7%生存率无法区分ECMO疗效与患者选择、转运至专科中心及照护质量的贡献；'carefully selected cases'的人群限定在结论中松动为普遍有效救援治疗，选择偏倚未量化（未报告筛选/排除人数）；心理结局系与外部系统综述作跨队列间接比较，非同期对照，比较基础不等（疾病构成、评估工具差异）；样本79例，各心理亚项与并发症多为探索性/次要指标，未见置信区间或P值
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: To review the clinical data of adult patients receiving veno-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO) for near-fatal asthma at a single UK respiratory ECMO centre, including morbidity and mortality follow up. DESIGN: Retrospective single-centre case series (2013-2025). SETTING: A specialized UK respiratory ECMO centre. PARTICIPANTS: 79 adult patients with near-fatal asthma refractory to maximal conventional critical care management including mechanical ventilation. INTERVENTIONS: Veno-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. MEASUREMENTS & MAIN RESULTS: 79 patients (median age 35 years, 53% female and 47% male) were included. Pre-ECMO physiological derangement was profound (median pH 7.05, PaCO2 14.7 kPa). Median ECMO duration was 3 days (IQR 2-4). Survival to ICU discharge and 6-month survival was 98.7%. Complications occurred in 27.8% of patients, most frequently acute kidney injury requiring renal replacement therapy (10.1%). At 6-month follow-up, clinically significant anxiety and depression were present in 27.9% and 20.9% of survivors, respectively, while 37.2% screened positive for post-traumatic stress symptoms. CONCLUSIONS: Veno-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO) represents an effective rescue therapy for patients with refractory near-fatal asthma, demonstrating excellent short- and long-term survival outcomes when applied in carefully selected cases. The incidence of complications remains acceptable and manageable within this context. The prevalence of anxiety and depression in this cohort appears to be lower than that reported in a published systematic review of the broader ECMO population; however, rates of post-traumatic stress symptoms are comparatively higher.

papers.abstract_en: Tuberculosis is the deadliest infectious disease, and treatments for multidrug-resistant tuberculosis are lengthy and toxic. By analyzing a large international database (N = 7,750), we identified patient risk phenotypes linked to unfavorable outcomes. Factors like HIV infection, age, low BMI, smoking, acid-fast bacillus smear positivity, extrapulmonary involvement, and cavitary disease were associated (p < 0.001) with worse clinical outcomes (ROC AUC 0.728; 95% CI 0.726-0.731) and were used to derive a patient risk score. Low-risk patients had a lower probability of unfavorable outcome over time since treatment initiation compared to high-risk patients (p < 0.001). External validation with a highly effective 6-month BPaL regimen showed 97% treatment success for low-risk patients and 88% for medium-to-high-risk patients. Stratifying patients by risk phenotype enables more effective, personalized tuberculosis interventions, which are key to improving cure rates.

papers.ai_note: 摘要未预先界定主要终点与主要比较，多个维度并列报告，易产生选择性强调空间；'准确性高'缺少金标准/参照标准的明确描述（由两名专家评分但未说明判定锚点），信息不足。可读性同时采用专家评分与Flesch-Kincaid自动分级，二者方向一致性未在摘要中给出具体数值。样本单位为问题而非患者，且仅覆盖免费版本、仅2名评分者、分歧以共识解决，无法评估评分者间信度。平台×领域交互显著但未给出分领域效应量。信息不足：各维度具体评分数值、效应量与CI均未报告。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by patients seeking lung cancer-related medical information. Recent studies have increasingly compared multiple LLMs for patient-facing medical information; however, differences in clinically relevant performance dimensions and consistency across repeated responses remain important areas for evaluation. METHODS: Seventy-nine lung cancer-related patient questions were queried across three freely accessible LLM platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini) between December 2025 and January 2026. Responses were independently evaluated by two specialist thoracic surgeons for accuracy, completeness, clinical relevance, and readability, with disagreements resolved by consensus. Reproducibility was assessed through five repeated independent queries using a clinical-equivalence framework, and automated readability was assessed using the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level. Ordinal outcomes were analyzed using cumulative link mixed models accounting for repeated evaluation of questions, while reproducibility was analyzed using generalized estimating equations. RESULTS: All platforms demonstrated high accuracy, with no significant overall platform difference (p = 0.150). Completeness differed significantly across platforms (p < 0.001), with higher ratings for ChatGPT than Claude and Gemini and for Claude than Gemini. Clinical relevance showed no overall platform effect (p = 0.568), although a platform-by-domain interaction was observed (p = 0.046). Expert-rated readability differed significantly (p < 0.001), with Gemini receiving higher ratings than ChatGPT and Claude. All platforms produced content requiring approximately 10th-12th grade reading levels. Reproducibility was high overall (88.6-96.2%), with no statistically significant overall platform effect (p = 0.072). CONCLUSIONS: Contemporary LLMs demonstrated high accuracy and clinical relevance, but differed in completeness and readability. Reproducibility was high across platforms, while all models exceeded recommended patient reading levels. Further patient-based validation is needed before routine clinical integration. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未报告不耐受组（n=61）与反应不足组（n=207）之间、以及各组与对照组之间差异的P值或CI，主要终点的组间比较仅给出点估计，无法判断统计学意义；样本量在两个暴露组上偏小且为单中心，存在选择偏倚（能进入手术路径者本身经过筛选）与残余混杂风险。药物相关术前体重变化（1.4%增重/1.5% TBWL）标注为estimated，来源方法未说明。结论中‘RYGB可能更优’仅基于反应不足组的校正分析，未在不耐受组或对照组作同样术式比较，属于亚组/单一人群外推。
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate 2-year weight loss after bariatric surgery among adults with intolerable adverse effects or inadequate weight loss with semaglutide or tirzepatide. SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: Semaglutide and tirzepatide are effective obesity medications, but intolerance and inadequate weight loss are common, creating uncertainty about next-step therapy. METHODS: This retrospective cohort included adults with BMI ≥35 kg/m² undergoing Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) or sleeve gastrectomy (SG) at Cleveland Clinic hospitals from 2018 to 2024. Electronic health record and dispensing data classified preoperative semaglutide or tirzepatide exposure and response. The primary outcome was estimated 2-year total body weight loss (TBWL), stratified by procedure and type 2 diabetes (T2DM) status. RESULTS: Among 4929 patients, 4661 had no prior exposure (comparator group), 61 discontinued semaglutide or tirzepatide because of intolerable adverse effects, and 207 had inadequate weight-loss response. Before surgery, estimated 2-year medication-associated weight change was a 1.4% gain in the intolerance group and 1.5% TBWL in the inadequate-response group. After surgery, 2-year TBWL in the intolerance group was 27.9% and 22.7% after RYGB and 20.1% and 21.6% after SG among patients without and with T2DM, respectively. Corresponding estimates in the inadequate-response group were 35.8%, 27.4%, 14.3%, and 14.2%. For comparison, corresponding 2-year TBWL estimates in the comparator group were 33.3%, 28.7%, 23.6%, and 19.9%. In adjusted analysis of the inadequate-response group, RYGB was associated with greater 2-year TBWL than SG (32.7% vs. 17.8%; difference, 14.9 percentage points [95% CI, 13.1%-16.7%]). CONCLUSIONS: Bariatric surgery was associated with clinically meaningful 2-year weight loss after semaglutide or tirzepatide intolerance or inadequate response, with RYGB potentially offering greater benefit after inadequate response.

papers.title_en: D-dimer/NT-proBNP ratio in acute pulmonary embolism patients stratifies risk of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension.
papers.authors: Spychalska K, Jermakow M, Kucharska J, Dzikowska-Diduch O, Perzanowska-Brzeszkiewicz K, Dudzik-Niewiadomska I, Łabyk A, Ou-Pokrzewińska A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Internal Medicine and Cardiology, Center for Management of Venous Thromboembolic Disease, Medical Universi…
papers.authors_conclusion: DD/NT-proBNP>10 μg·ng-1可识别后续CTEPH诊断低风险患者，而DD/NT-proBNP≤10、尤其超声心动图TRPG≥36 mmHg者构成随访期高风险组。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足/疑点：①切点10 μg·ng-1未说明是否为本队列数据驱动得出，无独立验证集，存在过拟合风险；②仅22个终点事件，摘要未见多因素校正，比值效能可能主要由NT-proBNP单组分驱动（D-dimer本身无差异）；③PPV仅11.7%，按此比值阳性者绝大多数不会发生CTEPH，作者以NPV和高风险组发生率为主要卖点；④中位随访39个月可能漏诊晚发CTEPH；⑤摘要未报告与既有评分（如简化Wells、右心功能指标）的增量比较。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: There are ongoing efforts to identify patients at risk of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH) during acute pulmonary embolism (APE). Lower D-dimer levels and right heart overload at APE diagnosis were reported to predict CTEPH. We hypothesised that plasma D-dimer to N-terminal pro-B type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) ratio assessed during APE may be useful for early CTEPH screening. METHODS: We followed 342 APE survivors (median age 64.5 years, female 56.1%), for a median of 39 (25-64) months. RESULTS: Despite ≥3 months anticoagulation CTEPH was diagnosed in 22 (6.4%) patients (CTEPH(+)). At APE diagnosis, CTEPH(+) compared with subjects without this sequela (CTEPH(-)) presented with advanced right ventricular overload: increased tricuspid regurgitation peak gradient (TRPG) (46.5 mmHg versus 32.0 mmHg; p<0.001) and NT-proBNP (1860 ng·L-1 versus 515 ng·L-1; p=0.02). Despite no differences in plasma D-dimer (4210 μg·L-1 versus 5330 μg·L-1; p=0.10), the ratio of D-dimer to NT-proBNP (DD/NT-proBNP) was significantly lower in the CTEPH(+) cohort versus the CTEPH(-) cohort (2.89 μg·ng-1 versus 12.0 μg·ng-1; p<0.001). In patients with DD/NT-proBNP≤10 CTEPH was diagnosed in 20 cases (11.7%), whereas in the group with DD/NT-proBNP> 10 CTEPH could only be detected in 2 of 171 cases (1.2%) with an OR 0.09 (95% confidence interval (CI) 0.02-0.38; p=0.0013), a sensitivity of 90.9% (95% CI 70.8-98.9%), a specificity 52.8% (95% CI 47.2-58.4%), a negative predictive value 98.8% (95% CI 95.8-99.9%), a and positive predictive value of 11.7% (95% CI 7.3-17.5%). Combination of DD/NT-proBNP≤10 with TRPG≥36 mmHg detected in 87 patients, including 17 patients with CTEPH (19.5% CTEPH incidence). CONCLUSION: DD/NT-proBNP>10 μg·ng-1 identifies patients with a low risk of subsequent CTEPH diagnosis, whereas DD/NT-proBNP≤10, especially presenting TRPG≥36 mmHg at echocardiography, forms a high risk group at follow-up.

papers.authors: Xu T, Peng Q, Li H, Wang M, Zhang J, Yu M, Chong C, Xue CC et al.

papers.abstract_en: There is an urgent global need for affordable, large-scale health screening to enhance preventive care in the ageing population. Using low-cost, non-invasive retinal photographs and leveraging large foundation models, we developed a deep learning-based biomarker, Retinal Mortality Equivalent (RetiME), that directly mapped retinal features to individual mortality risk. Trained on a European cohort and externally validated across three independent external cohorts spanning Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, RetiME showed robust associations with all-cause and cause-specific mortality and predicted the incidence of a wide range of systemic and ocular diseases. Crucially, beyond static risk estimation, RetiME re-timed mortality risk by reconstructing personalized lifespan trajectories that were associated with observed mortality outcomes (for example, age of death). Clustering of these trajectories revealed distinct mortality patterns, spanning cancer-predominant, cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative risks, reflecting diverse ageing pathways captured by RetiME. Interpretability analyses showed that RetiME captures diverse biological and retinal features underlying mortality risk. Genome-wide analyses further identified genetic loci associated with RetiME. Collectively, these findings support further evaluation of retinal imaging and trajectory modelling as one component of a comprehensive assessment of mortality risk.

papers.authors: Joy G, Punjabi K, Searle G, Abdulelah Z, Gantur T, Pierce I, Thornton GD, Meredith B et al.

Findings support the potential utility of AI for first-line ejection-fraction measurement with clinician oversight, although this should be investigated in prospective studies.
papers.ai_note: 校正年龄性别后判别力差异从ΔC 0·033骤降至0·004（CI 0·002-0·006），未校正模型的改善很大程度由混杂驱动，结论中'潜在用于一线测量'的外推超出该增量的实际临床意义；作者以AIC与似然比检验为主要支持证据，效应量本身边缘；研究为回顾性、CMR人群限定，摘要未报告校准度或决策曲线分析，信息不足；该领域与胸外科/胸部肿瘤业务关联有限
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Ejection fraction, a key measure of cardiac function, is used in health care for clinical decision making and risk stratification. We hypothesised that a deep-learning artificial intelligence (AI) segmentation of ejection fraction obtained from cardiac MRI (CMR) outperforms expert clinician segmentation for the prediction of all-cause mortality. METHODS: In this retrospective, multicentre, prognostic study, we studied a cohort of 27 382 consecutive patients who underwent cardiac MRI (CMR) in the UK and the USA. Patients were referred for CMR from nine hospitals to Barts Heart Centre (BHC), London. Patients were identified from the reporting archive at BHC as having undergone a CMR between Oct 1, 2014 and Dec 31, 2019. A further cohort of patients was also identified from University of Pittsburgh Medical Centre (UPMC), Pittsburgh, PA, USA, as having undergone a CMR between June 1, 2010 and March 31, 2016. Mortality data were obtained from national and local databases. AI segmentation was done on all CMR studies, and Cox proportional hazards models were fitted to compare the prognostic value of AI-measured versus clinician-measured left-ventricular volume metrics. Model fit was compared using the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC), discrimination using C indices and the incremental value of AI over clinician segmentation using likelihood-ratio tests of nested models. FINDINGS: 27 382 patients received a baseline CMR (26 106 patients from BHC and 1276 from UPMC). The median follow-up was 5·6 years (IQR 4·4-6·9), during which 3458 (13%) of 27 382 patients died. AI ejection fraction showed better model fit (AIC 57 936 vs 58 097, ΔAIC 161 favouring AI) and marginally better discrimination (C index 0·669 vs 0·637; ΔC 0·033 [95% CI 0·026-0·041]). AI ejection fraction significantly improved model fit when added to clinician ejection fraction (χ2=168, p<0·0001), with only slight improvement when clinician ejection fraction was added to AI (χ2=7·5, p=0·023). After adjustment for age and sex, AI-derived ejection fraction showed better model fit (AIC 55 684 vs 55 742; ΔAIC 59) and had marginally better discrimination (C index of 0·781 vs 0·777; ΔC=0·004 [95% CI 0·002-0·006]). INTERPRETATION: AI-derived ejection fraction shows marginally superior prediction for mortality than clinician-derived ejection fraction in patients who had CMR. Findings support the potential utility of AI for first-line ejection-fraction measurement with clinician oversight, although this should be investigated in prospective studies. FUNDING: National Institute for Health and Care Research Clinical Lectureship and the British Heart Foundation Accelerator Award.

papers.title_en: Health-Related Social Needs, Depression and Anxiety, and Asthma Outcomes in Adults with Utilization-defined Mild Asthma.
papers.authors: Schatz M, Zhou B, Zeiger RS, Crawford WW, Rozema E, Puttock EJ, Xie F, Vollmer WM et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Allergy Kaiser Permanente Southern California (KPSC), San Diego, CA, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: HRSN and depression are associated with poor asthma outcomes among adults with utilization-defined mild asthma. Assessing both social needs and mental health may help identify patients at greatest risk for poor asthma outcomes.
papers.ai_note: 横断面设计无法确立因果方向；人群以utilization定义为轻度哮喘，可能纳入了依从性差或治疗不足者，限制向真正临床轻度哮喘的外推；摘要未报告HRSN各层级的具体aRR数值，无法评估效应量大小；焦虑阴性结果被简略提及但不作为重点强调；校正变量仅含年龄、性别、种族/族裔，未校正吸烟、用药依从性、共病等潜在混杂
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Health-related social needs (HRSN) and depression or anxiety are associated with adverse asthma outcomes in patients with moderate-to-severe asthma, but their individual and combined associations with asthma outcomes among adults with mild asthma have not been well characterized. OBJECTIVE: To examine the individual and combined associations of HRSN, depression, and anxiety with asthma control and asthma-related healthcare utilization among adults with utilization-defined mild asthma. METHODS: A stratified sample of 3,787 adults with utilization-defined mild asthma completed a survey including the CMS HRSN Screening Tool, PHQ-2, GAD-2, AIRQ®, and self-reported asthma-related emergency department or urgent care visits during the previous 12 months. Modified Poisson regression evaluated associations after adjustment for age, sex, and race and ethnicity. RESULTS: More than half of participants reported at least one HRSN, and approximately one-quarter screened positive for depression or anxiety. Depression and HRSN frequently coexisted. Depression was associated with very poorly controlled asthma (adjusted relative risk [aRR] 1.48, 95% CI 1.17-1.86) after adjusting for age, sex and race/ethnicity. Compared with no HRSN, one or more HRSN were associated with very poorly controlled asthma, and two or more HRSN were associated with asthma-related emergency department or urgent care visits. Anxiety was not independently associated with either outcome. Participants with both HRSN and depression or anxiety experienced the greatest burden of adverse asthma outcomes. CONCLUSIONS: HRSN and depression are associated with poor asthma outcomes among adults with utilization-defined mild asthma. Assessing both social needs and mental health may help identify patients at greatest risk for poor asthma outcomes.

papers.title_zh: COPD合并肺癌患者免疫检查点抑制剂疗效与机制综述：临床获益或仅限于轻中度气流阻塞人群

papers.authors: Long Y, Liu Y, Miao K, Xiao D, Chen Y, Chen L, Tao Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, the Second Xiangya Hospital, Central South University, Changsha, Hun…
papers.authors_conclusion: Recent evidence suggests that COPD may confer an altered immunological microenvironment that paradoxically enhances responsiveness to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in patients with LC; benefits appearing largely attributable to patients with mild-to-moderate airflow obstruction; Current evidence remains limited by small retrospective cohorts and heterogeneous stratification. Large-scale prospective studies are warranted. This review aims to clarify the prognostic value of concomitant COPD and guide precision therapeutic strategies for this growing comorbid population.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，摘要未说明检索策略、纳入标准或文献质量评价方法，证据合成不可复现；'COPD增强ICI疗效'的核心主张来自小型回顾性队列，存在适应证/体能状态选择偏倚，且'获益集中于轻中度气流阻塞'疑为亚组或事后分析，属人群限定松动；摘要以机制假说（PD-L1升高、TMB升高、HLA-I表达、TRM/MAIT细胞富集、巨噬细胞极化）填充篇幅，但未给出任何效应量或统计学数据，无法据此判断临床效应大小；作者结论中'clarify the prognostic value'与自身承认的'evidence remains limited by small retrospective cohorts'存在张力；对安全性（CIP、哮喘/嗜酸粒细胞性气道疾病、甲状腺炎）仅提及'appraised'，未报告发生率数据；信息不足（无具体文献清单与数值）
papers.abstract_en: The coexistence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and lung cancer (LC) presents a complex clinical scenario with distinct pathological interactions. Beyond shared epidemiological and genetic risk factors, COPD reshapes the pulmonary immune microenvironment through reprogrammed immune-cell compartments, aberrant programmed cell death, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), fostering an immunologically "hot" but pathologically permissive milieu that simultaneously drives carcinogenesis and influences treatment responsiveness. Recent evidence suggests that COPD may confer an altered immunological microenvironment that paradoxically enhances responsiveness to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in patients with LC. This review mainly synthesizes clinical evidence on the efficacy of ICI, currently the most widely used immunotherapy, in LC patients concomitant with COPD and elucidates potential immunological and molecular mechanisms underlying observed clinical benefits, including heightened programmed cell death protein ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression, elevated tumor mutational burden, increased human leukocyte antigen I (HLA-I) expression, enriched tissue-resident memory T cells and mucosal-associated invariant T cells, and a macrophage polarization shift toward a pro-inflammatory phenotype, with benefits appearing largely attributable to patients with mild-to-moderate airflow obstruction. The safety profile of ICIs in this population-exacerbation risk, eosinophilic airway disease, checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis (CIP), and autoimmune thyroiditis-is appraised, alongside emerging strategies such as lymphocyte-activation gene 3 (LAG-3), T-cell immunoglobulin and mucin-domain containing-3 (TIM-3), and T cell immunoreceptor with Ig and ITIM domains (TIGIT) blockade and the immunomodulatory potential of COPD medications (inhaled corticosteroids and long-acting β-agonists). Current evidence remains limited by small retrospective cohorts and heterogeneous stratification. Large-scale prospective studies are warranted. This review aims to clarify the prognostic value of concomitant COPD and guide precision therapeutic strategies for this growing comorbid population.

papers.title_zh: 三元复合物KRAS G12C抑制剂RO3903快速靶点占领以克服耐药并驱动持久肿瘤消退（临床前证据）
papers.title_en: Rapid target engagement of KRAS G12C tricomplex inhibitor RO3903 overcomes resistance and drives durable tumor regression.
papers.authors: Yao X, Wang S, Xie J, Chen F, Qiu H, Li G, Jiang Z, Zhang W et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Oncology Discovery Department, China Innovation Center of Roche, Shanghai 201203, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: The high potency, fast target engagement, and brain tumor inhibition of RO3903 position this molecule as a valuable tool reagent and a promising partner for combination strategies to achieve durable tumor regression.
papers.ai_note: 全部为临床前证据，无人体数据，对临床决策仅具间接参考；摘要无任何定量数值（IC50、TGI%、生存期、CI/P），效应量无法评估，信息不足；作者自称'tool reagent'（工具化合物）与'promising'并存，定位与'promising partner'的临床暗示之间存在张力；'overcomes resistance''durable tumor regression'等结论均基于模型，外推至患者需谨慎；与OFF态抑制剂及免疫治疗的协同仅定性描述，无协同指数或增效数据。
papers.abstract_en: The clinical durability of first-generation KRAS G12C inhibitors is constrained by resistance mechanisms, primarily the rapid, receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK)-mediated reactivation of KRAS to its drug-insensitive, guanosine triphosphate (GTP)-bound (ON) state. Here, we perform a systematic comparative characterization of clinical and investigational KRAS G12C inhibitors, including Sotorasib, Adagrasib, Divarasib, and Elironrasib, and our structurally optimized tricomplex ON inhibitor, RO7783903 (RO3903). We demonstrate that the covalent tricomplex inhibitors RO3903 and Elironrasib effectively outpace dynamic nucleotide cycling, conferring resilience to potent RTK stimulation and overcoming the secondary KRAS mutations that drive clinical resistance to guanosine diphosphate (GDP)-bound (OFF) state inhibitors. Notably, RO3903 potently inhibits tumor growth in a dose-dependent manner across multiple preclinical models, including an orthotopic intracranial model. Furthermore, RO3903 exhibits synergistic efficacy when combined with inhibitors targeting OFF-state KRAS G12C, YAP-TEAD, EGFR/MET, or FAK, as well as with anti-PD1 antibody and anti-PD1/VEGF bispecific antibody immunotherapies. The high potency, fast target engagement, and brain tumor inhibition of RO3903 position this molecule as a valuable tool reagent and a promising partner for combination strategies to achieve durable tumor regression.

papers.title_en: State of the art: thoracic ultrasound.
papers.authors: Walsh OR, Bedawi EO, Rahman NM
papers.affiliation_highlight: Oxford Pleural Unit, Oxford Centre for Respiratory Medicine, Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust.
papers.authors_conclusion: The past year's literature confirms thoracic ultrasound's trajectory from a purely diagnostic adjunct towards a quantitative, procedure-integrated and artificial intelligence-supported modality, while also delivering important cautionary and negative findings that temper enthusiasm and clarify where evidence remains immature.
papers.ai_note: 摘要为叙述性综述，未给出任何具体效应量、CI或P值，关键信息不足（如大型多中心RCT中早期出院率的具体数值与显著性）。综述整体叙事以胸超向定量、流程整合、AI支持的积极演进为主轴，虽提及气胸/胸穿引导POCUS优于胸片的meta分析与AI缩短新手采集技能差距等正面结果，但AI自动判读（尤其B-line定量）与专家共识一致性仍不稳定，且急诊胸超驱动路径的主要终点为阴性——正负证据并置时摘要的乐观口径主要由次要/替代性结果支撑，需注意选择性强调风险。
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Thoracic ultrasound has continued to expand beyond simple bedside triage into a quantitative, procedure-guiding and increasingly artificial intelligence-augmented tool across pleural and respiratory medicine. This review summarizes the literature published over the past year, highlighting developments in effusion characterization, pneumothorax diagnosis, image-guided pleural procedures, artificial intelligence, training standards, critical care applications, malignant pleural effusion management, and diaphragm/interstitial lung disease assessment. RECENT FINDINGS: Elastography and contrast-enhanced ultrasound have moved from exploratory to comparative and multicentre randomized evaluation for effusion characterization and biopsy guidance. Meta-analyses have reaffirmed the superiority of point-of-care ultrasound over chest radiography for both pneumothorax and thoracentesis guidance. Artificial intelligence tools have shown that they can close the acquisition-skill gap for novice operators, although automated interpretation (particularly B-line quantification) remains inconsistent against expert consensus. A new UK national training standard for pleural procedures has been published, alongside the first validated thoracic-specific competency assessment tool. A large multicentre randomized trial found that a point-of-care ultrasound-driven diagnostic pathway did not improve early discharge rates in emergency department patients with dyspnoea, an important negative finding. Diaphragm and quantitative lung ultrasound continue to accumulate evidence as noninvasive markers of interstitial lung disease severity and ventilator weaning readiness. SUMMARY: The past year's literature confirms thoracic ultrasound's trajectory from a purely diagnostic adjunct towards a quantitative, procedure-integrated and artificial intelligence-supported modality, while also delivering important cautionary and negative findings that temper enthusiasm and clarify where evidence remains immature.

papers.abstract_en: Leptomeningeal carcinomatosis (LMC) is a rare but devastating complication of solid tumors. Involvement from esophageal cancer is exceedingly uncommon and poorly characterized, with evidence limited to case reports and small series. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were systematically searched by two investigators for LMC originating from esophageal cancer. Thirty-one studies reporting 43 patients were included (93% male; mean age 59.3 years). Esophageal adenocarcinoma was the predominant histology (86%), followed by squamous cell carcinoma (11.6%), most commonly from the distal esophagus or esophagogastric junction. LMC occurred synchronously in 27.9% and metachronously in 72.1%, with a median interval of 11.2 months between primary diagnosis and leptomeningeal disease. At diagnosis, 37.2% had isolated leptomeningeal involvement without extracranial metastases. Presentation was heterogeneous, most frequently including headache or meningeal symptoms (55.8%), vestibulocerebellar manifestations (39.5%), and cranial nerve involvement (37.2%). Cerebrospinal fluid cytology was positive in 81.1% of tested cases, often requiring repeat lumbar punctures. Molecular data were reported for 27.9% of patients; Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2) was positive in 3 of 10 tested cases (30%). Management was individualized: radiotherapy in 37.2%, intrathecal therapy in 20.9%, and supportive care alone in 46.5%. Median survival was 1.1 months, though three patients achieved 12, 14, and 19 months following Central Nervous System (CNS)-directed therapy. LMC from esophageal cancer is rare and clinically aggressive, characterized by heterogeneous presentation, frequent diagnostic delay, and poor prognosis. Early recognition and palliative care are essential, while rare long-term survivors suggest selected patients may benefit from individualized CNS-directed treatment.

papers.title_zh: Complement-driven NETosis mediates immunotherapy resistance in STK11-mutant lung adenocarcinoma.
papers.title_en: Complement-driven NETosis mediates immunotherapy resistance in STK11-mutant lung adenocarcinoma.
papers.authors: de Andrea CE, Ajona D, Sainz C, Remirez A, Echeveste JI, Amat R, de-Torres JP, Solomon B et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Clinica Universidad de Navarra Pamplona, Navarra Spain.
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Lung adenocarcinomas (LUADs) harboring concurrent mutations in KRAS and STK11 define a clinically aggressive subgroup characterized by primary resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). In contrast, KRAS/TP53 co-mutant tumors typically exhibit an inflamed tumor microenvironment (TME) and improved responsiveness to immunotherapy. The mechanisms underlying immune evasion in KRAS/STK11-mutant LUADs remain incompletely understood. EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN: We assembled a multicenter cohort of human LUAD specimens and performed integrative genomic and immunophenotypic analyses to dissect the TME of KRAS/STK11 (KS) and KRAS/TP53 (KP) co-mutant tumors. RESULTS: We identify neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation as a defining feature of KS tumors, associated with neutrophil enrichment and reduced CD8⁺ T-cell infiltration. Using immunocompetent Kras-mutant murine models, we demonstrate that Stk11 loss promotes NETosis through activation of the complement C5a-C5aR1 axis, resulting in an immunosuppressive TME and resistance to PD-1/PD-L1 blockade. Pharmacologic inhibition of C5a signaling suppresses NETosis, reduces tumor growth, and restores T-cell infiltration in KS tumors. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings uncover NETosis as a key mechanism of immune escape in KRAS/STK11-mutant LUADs and identify the C5a-C5aR1 pathway as a therapeutically actionable vulnerability to overcome immunotherapy resistance in this patient population. These findings provide a rationale for biomarker-driven clinical strategies targeting the complement pathway in patients with STK11-mutant lung adenocarcinoma.

papers.abstract_en: RATIONALE: Early prediction of lung function decline remains challenging in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and fibrotic interstitial lung diseases (ILDs). We evaluated whether oxygen desaturation during the 6-min walk test (6MWT) predicts forced vital capacity (FVC) decline and long-term outcomes. METHODS: We analysed data from two independent cohorts: the nationwide Japanese Idiopathic Interstitial Pneumonias (JIPS) Registry and an external IPF cohort (K-Junko Study). Hazard ratios (HRs) were estimated for each 6MWT parameter to identify variables associated with FVC decline and to determine optimal thresholds. Sensitivity analyses were conducted using Fine-Gray models. The performance of the predictive model was assessed using calibration plots and the concordance index (C-index). RESULTS: In the JIPS IPF (n=457) and K-Junko IPF (n=318) cohorts, a peripheral oxygen saturation (S pO2 ) change of ≤-6 percentage points during the 6MWT independently predicted a decline in FVC of ≥5 percentage points in both cohorts (JIPS HR 1.292; K-Junko HR 1.480). Moreover, S pO2 change during the 6MWT was significantly associated with FVC change in the subsequent year, and this association persisted over 5 consecutive years in JIPS IPF cohort. The nomogram demonstrated moderate discrimination (C-index: 0.619 (training) and 0.632 (validation)) and fair calibration. A composite profile meeting all three criteria (FVC ≥80%, S pO2 change >-6 percentage points, 6-min walk distance (6MWD) ≥420 m) identified patients with favourable transplant-free survival. In the JIPS non-IPF fibrotic ILD cohort (n=387), S pO2 change remained the sole independent predictor of an FVC decline of ≥5 percentage points (HR 1.350). CONCLUSION: S pO2 change during the 6MWT predicts FVC decline and outcomes across fibrotic ILD; its incorporation into routine assessment may enable earlier risk stratification and facilitate timely intervention.

papers.title_zh: Myeloid-derived TGFβ1 and oncostatin M establish two distinct stromal niches controlling late and hybrid EMT states.
papers.title_en: Myeloid-derived TGFβ1 and oncostatin M establish two distinct stromal niches controlling late and hybrid EMT states.
papers.authors: Dong A, Vanuytven S, González AP, Bévant K, Van de Putte L, Zahedi Z, Allard J, Dubois C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Laboratory of Stem Cells and Cancer, Université Libre de Bruxelles, Brussels, Belgium.
papers.abstract_en: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) regulates tumor progression, metastasis and resistance to therapy. EMT encompasses a continuum of tumor states displaying different functions. The precise dialog between the tumor microenvironment and the different EMT states remains poorly understood. Using single-cell and spatial transcriptomics of mouse skin tumors, we uncover that different EMT states are associated with different niches. Neutrophils are more abundant in niches associated with hybrid EMT and secreted oncostatin M, which partially activates EMT while sustaining the epithelial program, promoting hybrid EMT states and metastasis formation. Macrophages are more abundant in niches associated with more advanced EMT states, which, together with other stromal cells, express TGFβ1 that promotes the late EMT state. Oncostatin M and TGFβ1 function in a feed-forward manner by creating distinct inflammatory niches to maintain specific EMT states. Together, our results reveal that distinct niches are associated with specific EMT states and that signaling pathways sustain their own niche's identity by recruiting specific myeloid cell populations.

papers.title_zh: Sitagliptin, a repurposed diabetes drug, overcomes gemcitabine resistance in pancreatic cancer via ribonucleotide reductase inhibition: SITGEM-CARE phase 2 trial.
papers.title_en: Sitagliptin, a repurposed diabetes drug, overcomes gemcitabine resistance in pancreatic cancer via ribonucleotide reductase inhibition: SITGEM-CARE phase 2 trial.
papers.authors: Yu J, Shi S, Li M, Fang Q, Yan J, Zhang Y, Liu Z, Li Z et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Pancreas Center, Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute & Hospital, Tianjin, China.
papers.abstract_en: Gemcitabine resistance remains a major therapeutic barrier in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), for which median survival in advanced disease has remained near one year despite extensive clinical investigation. Using artificial intelligence (AI)-guided structure-based drug repurposing, we identified sitagliptin, a DPP-4 inhibitor for diabetes, as a candidate ribonucleotide reductase (RRM1/2) inhibitor that sensitizes PDAC to gemcitabine. Molecular dynamics simulations suggested that sitagliptin disrupts gemcitabine-RRM1/2 interactions, downregulating RRM1/2 expression and restoring chemosensitivity across PDAC cell lines, patient-derived organoids, and mouse models. Sitagliptin enhanced the anti-tumor efficacy of both gemcitabine-nab-paclitaxel (GnP) and FOLFIRINOX regimens in preclinical studies. We conducted SITGEM-CARE, a single-center phase 2 trial in 22 patients with locally advanced or metastatic PDAC (median age 65.0 years; ECOG performance status 1, 86.4%; Stage IV, 68.2%; liver metastases, 54.5%). Patients received sitagliptin 100 mg orally once daily continuously, plus gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² and nab-paclitaxel 125 mg/m² on days 1 and 8 of 21-day cycles. Among 22 evaluable patients, eight achieved a partial response, and 11 had stable disease, yielding an objective response rate of 36.4% (95% CI: 17.2-59.3%) and a disease control rate of 86.4% (95% CI: 65.1-97.1%), with tumor shrinkage in 86.4% of patients. At a median follow-up of 9.9 months, the median progression-free survival was 6.6 months (95% CI: 4.8-12.4) with 6-month and 9-month PFS rates of 63.6% and 43.5%, respectively. Median overall survival was 12.5 months (95% CI: 7.8-not reached), with 62.9% of patients alive at 12 months. Furthermore, treatment was well tolerated, with no Grade 4/5 treatment-related adverse events. These findings are hypothesis-generating and warrant confirmation in adequately powered, randomized trials. ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT05947825.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Nintedanib is approved for various interstitial lung diseases (ILDs). Although sarcopenia, which is characterized by a loss of skeletal muscle mass, is known to affect the outcome of ILD, the outcome of patients with sarcopenia receiving nintedanib remains unclear. METHODS: Fifty-six patients with ILD who were initiated on nintedanib between 2015 and 2023 were included. On CT images obtained prior to the introduction of nintedanib, the thoracic skeletal muscle area at the T4 level was measured to estimate the skeletal muscle index (SMI). Patients with an SMI in the lowest quartile were defined as the sarcopenia group, and the remaining patients as the non-sarcopenia group. The times from the start of nintedanib to all-cause death (overall survival: OS) and the first acute exacerbation (exacerbation-free survival: EFS) were compared between the two groups. Dose reduction and discontinuation rate of nintedanib were also evaluated. The cut-off date was determined to be 5 years. RESULTS: Whereas age, sex, and serum levels of albumin and Klebs von den Lungen-6 did not differ between the two groups, forced vital capacity (%FVC) (63.7% vs. 72.7%), diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (%DLco) (41% vs. 55.9%) and body mass index (20.6 vs. 25.2 kg/m2) were significantly lower in the sarcopenia group (n = 14) than in the non-sarcopenia group (n = 42). The OS was significantly shorter in the sarcopenia group (26.5 months vs. not reached, P = 0.03). Similarly, EFS was significantly shorter in the sarcopenia group (15.8 vs. 44.6 months, P = 0.002). In the multivariate Cox proportional hazard models adjusted for age and sex, %FVC and baseline sarcopenia were significantly associated with OS (%FVC: hazard ratio (HR) 0.96, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.93-0.98, P = 0.005, sarcopenia: HR 3.37, 95% CI 1.27-8.93, P = 0.01). Likewise, %FVC, %DLco and sarcopenia were significantly associated with EFS (%FVC: HR 0.96, 95% CI 0.93-0.98, P = 0.0004, %DLco: HR 0.96, 95% CI 0.94-0.98, P = 0.0006, sarcopenia. HR 2.79, 95% CI 1.23-6.34, P = 0.01). Although all patients in the sarcopenia group required a dose reduction or discontinuation of nintedanib, 21.5% of the non-sarcopenia group did not require such adjustments (P = 0.01). CONCLUSIONS: Patients with sarcopenia and ILD may benefit less from nintedanib.

papers.authors: Naeem H, Diboun I, Siddig Z, Ghorbani M, Hassan S, Farhad R, Moosa S, Abouelhassan R et al.

papers.abstract_en: Ancestry-specific genetic mapping of transcriptome regulation is pivotal for understanding genome function, especially in underrepresented consanguineous populations. Here we characterized 1,882 Qatar Biobank participants, integrating blood RNA sequencing, whole-genome sequencing and phenotypic data across 45 clinically relevant traits. We cataloged ~7 million significant quantitative trait loci (QTLs), both short and structural variants, impacting gene expression, isoform usage, splicing and allele-specific expression, uncovering 1,379 novel eGenes. Fine-mapping resolved 29,953 high-confidence, independent causal loci including 24% previously unreported as well as those with effect alleles showing significant divergence across global populations, while 1,371 were absent from public databases. Leveraging elevated autozygosity, we found that causal variants are depleted from runs of homozygosity, consistent with purifying selection, while recent autozygosity increased the burden of homozygous regulatory variants. We identified QTLs with recessive deleterious effects on 10 Mendelian disease genes and homozygous QTLs causing extreme outlier expression in 66 genes including dosage-sensitive ones. Colocalization analysis revealed 58 causal variants acting on 20 clinically relevant phenotypes, implicating novel genes including ATP6V0B and RQCD1 in metabolic and blood disorders. These findings establish this QTL catalog as a valuable Middle Eastern resource for genome interpretation and genomic medicine.

papers.abstract_en: Chemotherapy remains the backbone of neoadjuvant treatment for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), and response to chemotherapy strongly correlates with patient prognosis. However, predicting chemoresistance remains a major clinical challenge. To address this obstacle, we performed serial fine needle aspirations followed by RNA-sequencing on patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models of TNBC that were either chemoresponsive or chemoresistant. We found that these two classes of PDX models exhibited distinct transcriptional trajectories that diverged within one week of chemotherapy initiation, preceding measurable changes in tumor volume. At early time points, chemoresponsive tumors showed activation of apoptotic and cytokine-related pathways, while these changes were absent in chemoresistant models. Notably, cytokine upregulation in chemoresponsive tumors coincided with infiltration of myeloid-derived immune cells into the tumor bed within seven days of chemotherapy, indicating active microenvironment remodeling, even in mice lacking a fully intact immune system. Analysis of paired biopsies from patients with TNBC collected before treatment and within four days of the first chemotherapy dose revealed a consistent pattern: chemoresponsive tumors upregulated inflammatory pathways, whereas chemoresistant tumors showed diminished activation of these pathways. These results underscore the potential clinical value of early on-treatment tumor sampling to detect chemoresistance and guide therapeutic intervention.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Persistent respiratory symptoms are common in Fire Department of the City of New York (FDNY) rescue/recovery workers following the World Trade Center (WTC) collapse on 11 September 2001 and some continue to experience symptoms despite normal spirometry without bronchodilator response. Respiratory oscillometry is a sensitive method for detecting small airways dysfunction and identifies abnormalities undetected by spirometry. This study evaluated whether respiratory oscillometry is associated with respiratory symptoms among workers with normal spirometry, and qualitatively assessed this association stratified by serum eosinophilia. METHODS: We analysed a cohort of FDNY WTC-exposed rescue/recovery workers who completed same-day respiratory oscillometry, spirometry and symptom questionnaires. We included only those with normal spirometry without obstruction, defined as forced expiratory volume in 1 s (FEV1), forced vital capacity (FVC) and FEV1/FVC greater than the lower limit of normal and no bronchodilator response. Logistic regression estimated associations between oscillometry z-scores (as continuous variables in separate models) and symptom burden. Models were adjusted for age, race, WTC arrival time, smoking status and body mass index. Analyses were also stratified by eosinophilia status. RESULTS: Resistance at 5 Hz (R5) was associated with persistently high symptom count (odds ratio (OR) 1.36, 95% CI 1.11-1.66) and high symptom severity (OR 1.32, 95% CI 1.05-1.67). Frequency dependence of resistance (the difference between resistance at 5 Hz and resistance at 20 Hz (R5-R20)) was also associated with persistently high symptom count (OR 1.31, 95% CI 1.11-1.56). Associations for R5 and R5-R20 were greatest in those with eosinophilia (≥300 cells·μL-1). CONCLUSION: In symptomatic individuals with normal spirometry, oscillometry is sensitive for detecting airways dysfunction, supporting our hypothesis that persistent, severe symptoms are attributable to disease in the small airways. Larger associations with eosinophilia identify a phenotype that may inform early intervention and treatment.

papers.ai_note: 纯临床前体外机制研究，无患者数据或体内疗效验证，临床转化价值信息不足；摘要全篇无定量统计数值，关键结论（如脂质谱变化幅度、铁死亡敏感性差异）缺乏数据支撑，无法评估效应量
papers.abstract_en: KRAS inhibitors represent a promising therapeutic frontier in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) treatment. However, the clinical benefit of KRAS inhibitors in PDAC is limited by the frequent emergence of resistance. Here, we demonstrated that acquisition of resistance to KRAS inhibitors rendered PDAC cells hypersensitive to ferroptosis. Untargeted lipidomic profiling revealed that resistant cells underwent extensive lipid metabolic reprogramming characterized by selective enrichment of polyunsaturated fatty acid-containing phosphatidylcholines (PC-PUFAs) and a concomitant reduction in monounsaturated fatty acid-containing species (PC-MUFAs). The orphan nuclear receptor NR2F2 was a critical determinant of ferroptosis sensitivity in resistant cells. NR2F2 expression was markedly elevated upon acquisition of resistance, accompanied by substantial changes in its occupancy at regulatory elements of key lipid metabolic genes. By altering chromatin accessibility, NR2F2 drove PUFA biosynthesis and phospholipid remodeling, creating a ferroptosis-prone lipid state. Collectively, these findings establish NR2F2-driven lipid metabolic rewiring as an intrinsic ferroptosis liability in KRAS inhibitor-resistant PDAC and reveal ferroptosis induction as a therapeutic strategy to overcome resistance to KRAS-targeted therapies.

papers.study_type: 网络建模（TargetScore）+磷酸化蛋白质组学驱动的联合用药临床前研究（体外/体内及基因工程小鼠模型验证）
